Field.name: InputTransforms
Field.usage: Input file, usually of post-rotation transforms

Field.name: OutputTransforms
Field.usage: Output file, usually for complete transforms

Field.name: RotationAngle
Field.usage: Rotation angle from the Y axis to the tilt axis
Field.manpage: Angle of rotation of the tilt axis in the images; specifically, the angle from the vertical to the tilt axis (counterclockwise positive).

Field.name: BeamTilt
Field.usage: Angle between the beam axis and perpendicular to the tilt axis

Field.name: FirstTiltAngle
Field.usage: Tilt angle of first view in degrees
Field.manpage: Tilt angle of first view, in degrees. Use this option together with TiltIncrement.

Field.name: TiltIncrement
Field.manpage: Increment between tilt angles, in degrees. Use this option together with FirstTiltAngle.

Field.name: TiltFile
Field.manpage: Use this option if tilt angles are in a file, one per line.

Field.name: TiltAngles
Field.usage: Individual tilt angles for each view
Field.manpage: Use this option to enter the tilt angles for each view individually, in degrees.

Field.name: NewTiltFile
Field.usage: Output file for new tilt angles

Field.name: XAxisTilt
Field.usage: X axis tilt of the unrotated reconstruction

Field.name: XTiltFile
Field.usage: Input file with X-axis tilts to be applied in reconstruction

Field.name: NewXTiltFile
Field.usage: Output file for new X-axis tilts
